tools.name: fakturoid_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the Fakturoid user behind the integration, with the accounts it can access. Use to check the connection. Fakturoid API: GET /api/v3/user.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_get_account
tools.description: Get the account settings: name, currency, VAT payer status, address and plan. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/account.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: List the bank accounts used on invoices. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/bank_accounts.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_list_number_formats
tools.description: List the invoice number sequences (number formats) of the account. Use to find the id of a sequence. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/number_formats/invoices.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_list_subjects
tools.description: List customers and suppliers (subjects), 40 per page. Filter by creation or update time, or by your own custom_id. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/subjects.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_search_subjects
tools.description: Search subjects by name, email, registration number or VAT number. 40 per page. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/subjects/search.json?query=.

tools.name: fakturoid_get_subject
tools.description: Get one subject (customer or supplier) by id. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/subjects/{id}.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_list_invoices
tools.description: List issued invoices, proformas, corrections and tax documents, 40 per page. Filter by dates, subject, number, status or document type. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/invoices.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its lines, totals, payment state and subject. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/invoices/{id}.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_list_expenses
tools.description: List received expenses (supplier invoices and receipts), 40 per page. Filter by dates, subject, number, variable symbol or status. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/expenses.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_get_expense
tools.description: Get one expense with its lines, totals and payment state. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/expenses/{id}.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_list_inventory_items
tools.description: List inventory items (products and services) with prices and stock quantity, 40 per page. Fakturoid API: GET /accounts/{slug}/inventory_items.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_create_subject
tools.description: Create a customer or supplier record. Writes to the account: creates one new subject each call. Fakturoid API: POST /accounts/{slug}/subjects.json.

tools.name: fakturoid_update_subject
tools.description: Change fields of an existing subject. Only the fields you pass change. Fakturoid API: PATCH /accounts/{slug}/subjects/{id}.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fakturoid_search_subjects · Private data: fakturoid_list_invoices, fakturoid_create_subject · Public sink: fakturoid_search_subjects, fakturoid_create_subject.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fakturoid_search_subjects · Private data: fakturoid_list_invoices, fakturoid_create_subject · Public sink: fakturoid_search_subjects, fakturoid_create_subject

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
